WITH product AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Heco'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp
      WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku
        AND pvp.property_key = 'fastener type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'bolt'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp
      WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku
        AND pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '10 mm'
    )
),
vienna_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, record_path AS store_record_path
  FROM stores
  WHERE city = 'Vienna'
),
inventory AS (
  SELECT vs.store_id, si.available_today_quantity
  FROM vienna_stores vs
  LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = vs.store_id AND si.product_sku = (SELECT product_sku FROM product)
)
SELECT json_array(
  json_object(
    'product_sku', (SELECT product_sku FROM product),
    'product_record_path', (SELECT product_record_path FROM product),
    'store_record_paths', (SELECT json_group_array(store_record_path) FROM vienna_stores),
    'total_available', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(available_today_quantity) FROM inventory), 0)
  )
) AS result;
